message: My payment was deducted but my order was cancelled. I have not received my refund and it has been 5 days.
I want to cancel my order because I placed it by mistake. Can you tell me if I am eligible for a refund?
My card was charged twice for the same order. I only placed one order.
My order was cancelled after payment was captured, but I still cannot see the refund in my account.
The support agent asked me for my OTP and CVV to process my refund. Is that required?
My order was cancelled and I don't understand why. What should I do next?
